summary.soft: Clear caches, temporary files, and UI layout state while keeping settings and data.
summary.appData: Remove app state, workspace runtime, and cache. Optionally keep logs and credentials.
summary.factory: Erase all Sparo OS-managed local data, including credentials and browser profiles.

details.soft: Frees space by clearing caches, temporary files, and UI layout state. Settings, credentials, and workspace data stay intact.
details.appData: Returns the app to a clean state. Settings, application state, workspace and Agentic OS runtime, installed apps, and cache are deleted. Choose whether to also delete logs, credentials, and browser profiles before running the reset.
details.factory: Wipes everything Sparo OS manages, including credentials, browser profiles, custom agents, skills, and managed runtimes.

soft.title: Clear caches?
soft.message: This clears caches, temporary files, and UI layout state. Settings, credentials, and workspace data are kept.

appData.title: Reset application data?
appData.message: This permanently deletes the selected application data and cannot be undone. Your project source files are never touched, and the app will restart once the reset completes.

factory.title: Factory reset?
factory.message: This permanently deletes all Sparo OS-managed data on this device and cannot be undone. The app will restart once the reset completes.

backup.label: Create a reset backup
backup.description: Copy configuration and state into a backup folder before deleting.

secrets.label: Include secrets
secrets.description: Also delete stored credentials and authorization vaults.

browser.label: Include browser profiles
browser.description: Also delete Sparo-managed browser login state and profiles.

messages.resetComplete: Reset {{resetId}} completed and freed {{size}}. Restart Sparo OS before continuing.
messages.openFolderFailed: Could not open this folder in the file explorer.
